faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIO Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Senior Project Associate post at NIO is 16 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIO Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Project Associate post in the National Institute of Oceanography recruitment drive. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates seeking government jobs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIO Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Senior Project Associate position at NIO is online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the official website of the National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Senior Project Associate at NIO?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Project Associate position will receive a salary of Rs. 42000 per month. This is a contractual government job opportunity with a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech/M.E (relevant fields) with 2 years experience, OR B.E/B.Tech (Civil) with 3 years experience, OR M.Sc Physical Oceanography with 3 years experience, OR Ph.D (Oceanography/Marine Science) with 2 years experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIO Senior Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Senior Project Associate recruitment at NIO. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location for NIO Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Project Associate position is Goa, India. The National Institute of Oceanography is primarily based in Goa, offering a coastal work environment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website to apply for NIO recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for applying to NIO recruitment is https://www.nio.res.in. All eligible candidates can find the application link and detailed notification on this portal.

faq.answer: The Senior Project Associate position at NIO is a contractual job type. This offers a fixed-term employment opportunity within a government organization, suitable for project-based work.
